title: Wonders of Kazakhstan with FREE Tickets to Kob Tobe Gondola Ride
highlights: Enjoy an amazing cable car ride to Kok Tobe, the highest point of the city and admire the views of Almaty's skyline from its various vantage points.
Spend some peaceful time at the stunning Ascension Cathedral, known to be one of the highest wooden Orthodox churches in the world.
Visit the largest and oldest ski resort in Kazakhstan, Skymbulak, and enjoy being surrounded by the pristine beauty of the Tian Shan Mountains.
Take a leisurely walk along the shorelines of Issyk Lake, a beautiful lake surrounded by thick and dense forests and stunning flower fields.
inclusions: Transfer from Almaty International Airport to Deluxe Hotel

know_before_you_go: Carry a form of identification, such as your passport or a government-issued ID as it may be required for certain activities or services.
Carry some local currency Kazakhstani Tenge (KZT), as not all places may accept credit cards.
Dress modestly, especially when visiting religious sites or rural areas.
Do not consume alcoholic beverages or drugs, if you are found intoxicated, you might be asked to leave the premises of attractions.
Kazakhstan is one of the most environmentally conscious regions in the world, so make sure you give importance to sustainable travel practices.
Tipping is not mandatory but is appreciated in restaurants and for certain services.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Almaty
days.desc: Welcome to the City of Apples, Almaty! Upon your arrival, get transferred to the hotel and check-in. After you relax for some time, explore this beautiful city on your own by visiting places like the vibrant Zelyony Bazaar and Abai Square. You can also visit the stunning Palace of President and Palace of Republic and admire their contemporary architectural styles. Later, return to the hotel at your own pace for an overnight stay.

days.title: Almaty Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: Today, spend time exploring Almaty on a sightseeing tour. Get transferred from the hotel and see some of the city's iconic places, like the Panfilov Park, dedicated to the Panfilove heroes who took part in World War II. Then, see the beautiful Ascension Cathedral, a famous Russian Orthodox cathedral. Lastly, visit the beautiful Republic Square and see the Monument of Independence, known as the symbol of freedom for Kazakhstan. Afterward, get transferred back to the hotel for an overnight stay.

items.title: Almaty City Sightseeing Tour on a Private basis

days.title: Day Trip to Shymbulak Ski Resort
days.desc: Enjoy a day in the beautiful mountains surrounding Almaty City on this amazing day trip to Shymbulak Ski Resort and Medeu Ice Skating Rink. Get transferred from the hotel to Medeu and enjoy skiing in one of the largest alpine skating rinks in the world. Then, enjoy a cable car ride to Shymbulak Ski Resort and enjoy panoramic views of the surroundings on the way. Later, get transferred back to the hotel for an overnight stay.

items.title: Day Trip to Medeu Ice Skating Rink & Shymbulak Ski Resort on a Private basis

days.title: Trip to Green Bazaar & Rahat Chocolate Factory | Visit to Kok Tobe Park
days.desc: Today, get transferred from the hotel to Green Bazaar. In this all-in-one bazaar, you can buy all kinds of items, from souvenirs to clothes and snacks. Then, enjoy a brief stopover at Rahat Chocolate Factory to see in detail the process of chocolate as you buy a few of them. Next, get transferred to the city center to board your cable car to Kok Tobe Park, where you can enjoy rides and admire the views of the panoramic surroundings. Later, get transferred back to the hotel for an overnight stay

days.title: Day Trip to Issyk Lake
days.desc: Admire the beauty of Issky Lake on a wonderful day trip. Get transferred from the hotel to Lake Issky, located in the scenic Issky Gorge. Upon reaching there, enjoy a leisurely walk around the shores as you take-in the views of the surroundings. Also, visit the State Historical and Cultural Museum-Reserve and learn about the area's past and history. Later, get transferred back to the hotel for an overnight stay.
